name: Card click opens the side preview; the detail page renders Config/Preview/Versioning tabs
description: From /skills, click the seeded breaking-change card: the preview opens in a SIDE DRAWER (right panel) showing the skill's body — not a modal and not a navigation. Then follow 'Open full editor' into /skills/:id and confirm exactly the three detail tabs (Config, Preview, Versioning) render. Tab labels are DOM-cased (no CSS text-transform on the Tabs kit), so wait --text uses that casing. Read-only.
